name: agent-manager
description: Generated workflow operator commands. Routine inspection is metadata-only; payload results require explicit authorization.

groups.name: workflow
groups.description: Catalog, simulate, run, inspect, and control durable agent workflows

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate and canonicalize one workflow definition without writes

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Dry-run all scenario workflow sources without catalog writes

commands.name: reconcile-scenario
commands.description: Atomically reconcile all valid scenario-owned workflow sources

commands.name: reload
commands.description: Reload and atomically activate one scenario's valid workflow source set

commands.name: list
commands.description: List immutable workflow revisions for an owner

commands.name: get
commands.description: Get one immutable workflow revision by key or digest

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain a workflow revision and its authored provenance

commands.name: simulate
commands.description: Statically plan node identities, strategies, waits, joins, and child workflows without side effects

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start an idempotent execution pinned to one immutable workflow revision

commands.name: execution-list
commands.description: List bounded metadata-only workflow execution history

commands.name: execution-get
commands.description: Inspect one execution with input and output redacted

commands.name: execution-result
commands.description: Inspect input and output only after explicit operator authorization

commands.name: execution-advance
commands.description: Reconcile one execution from its durable state without duplicating dispatched work

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Inspect metadata-only attempt and durable journal history

commands.name: signal
commands.description: Deliver one typed, idempotent signal to the exact durable wait

commands.name: cancel
commands.description: Idempotently cancel an execution and propagate cancellation to active runs and children

commands.name: retry
commands.description: Retry the failed node using its durable attempt lineage and retry budget

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Resume a recoverable execution without creating duplicate node work
